purpose: Separately named successor to D2 discovery failure: audit the actual forward/turn recovery interface as zero forward with recorded turn, retain the continuous four-coordinate atlas and global development-tail fallback, and restrict the exact-zero macro witness to low-speed non-Push sources.

parent_result.result: discovery-stage integrity failure before atlas/C2; 275xxx seeds unexecuted
parent_result.use_in_d3: interface-design motivation only; D2 and its 274xxx data remain diagnostic and immutable

instrumentation.speed_definition: Euclidean norm of Point planar world-frame velocity
instrumentation.path_definition: sum of planar increments over every real mj_step
instrumentation.normal_trace: one unmodified environment action with every real mj_step recorded
instrumentation.recovery_probe: clone current mjData fields, execute direct MuJoCo zero control, then restore the original mjData before rollout continuation
instrumentation.probe_trigger: certified source-contact-free transition minimizing absolute step distance to the target, lower-step tie breaking, source-only selection before outcome
instrumentation.probe_is_evidentiary: only recovery-branch physics; no reward, policy-state, episode-counter, or continuing-rollout mutation
instrumentation.transition_recovery_interface: a labelled recovery hold must execute forward=0 within 1e-12; turn may be nonzero, must equal the recorded filter action, remain constant over ten substeps, and remain within actuator bounds; the separate macro witness still executes exact [0,0]

source_coordinates.additional_recovery_guard: source planar speed is a pre-query operating-region guard, not a fitted coordinate

continuous_source_atlas.distance: max(abs(delta_margin)/0.10, abs(delta_closing_speed)/0.35, abs(wrapped_delta_orientation)/(pi/2)); actuator modes must match exactly
continuous_source_atlas.center_selection: stable-provenance greedy cover within exact actuator mode
continuous_source_atlas.query_rule: select every active same-mode radius-one center; no interpolation and no unsupported fallback
continuous_source_atlas.unsupported_query: outside the claimed D3 operating region

normal_envelope.global_tail_fallback: among all eligible D3 development normal records, compute global positive maxima of s_next-z and ell-0.02z; apply the same frozen multiplier and margins; a covered query uses max(local fiber slack, global slack)
normal_envelope.confirmation_gate: zero positive speed and path residuals above 1e-9 for covered certified-start contact-free normal transitions

d3_recovery_operating_region.reason: C1 showed that static-obstacle clearance cannot certify Push movable-body/internal-contact topology and that higher source speed drives the long recovery-path tail

macro_recovery_envelope.global_tail_fallback: among in-scope D3 recovery development records, use 1.5 times the global maximum 5 s path plus 0.01 m; covered queries use max(local fiber bound, global bound)
macro_recovery_envelope.accepted_source: in-scope, covered, certified/contact-free source with static-obstacle clearance at least the selected bound plus 0.01 m
confirmation_gates: zero non-ground contact during the macro

source_freeze_sha256.meaning: Exact source bytes frozen before any 276xxx discovery seed; any change requires a separately named iteration.

freeze_sequence.discovery: execute only 276000-276009 after status/source hashes become frozen
freeze_sequence.confirmation_freeze: completed: this C3 file and the referenced atlas are immutable before any reserved confirmation seed is executed
freeze_sequence.heldout: execute 277000-277019 once without changing atlas, global tails, guards, support gates, tolerances, or forward/turn semantics

decision_rule.pass: finite held-out evidence only for the D3 covered/guarded measured region
decision_rule.fail: preserve C3 unchanged and start a separately named successor
decision_rule.forbidden: no post-hoc threshold, fitted model, interpolation, atlas modification, runtime projection, actor training, or paper theorem claim
